description: The `match` statement: compares a subject with `case` patterns that check its shape and bind its parts.
Not an expression: a description of a shape (literal, capture, wildcard, value, sequence, mapping or class) tried against the subject.
A bare name in a pattern. It matches anything and binds it; it never compares with an existing variable.
A case that always matches (`case _:` or a bare capture without a guard). It must be the last case.
`match` and `case` are keywords only in a match statement, so they stay valid names elsewhere.
